items.title: The Cell — XP Greenfield Giga Factory
items.hmw: How might we design a seamless, human-centered workplace experience framework for Lilly's new giga factory — built to scale with the business?
items.challenge: Create a seamless experience: design a safer, smoother and future-ready onsite experience aligned with Lilly's operational excellence and growth ambition for the gigafactory.
approach: Immersive research (site visit, user interviews, benchmark)
Opportunities structured across Spaces, Services, Technologies and Ways of Working
outcome: Strategic Experience Playbook for the future site
items.results: Helped Lilly shape a scalable, people-centered workplace ecosystem that enhances operational flow, strengthens engagement, and supports long-term growth.

items.title: Flagship Campus in Cambridge
items.hmw: How might we design a seamless, high-impact workplace experience that supports innovation, collaboration, and scientific excellence?
items.challenge: Elevate the campus experience: enhance the daily experience across spaces, services and touchpoints — aligning operational excellence with employee expectations in a world-class research environment.
outcome: Quick wins and long-term transformation levers
Phased roadmap aligned with operational delivery
items.results: Positioned AstraZeneca Cambridge with a cohesive, future-ready campus experience vision — strengthening engagement, supporting performance, and enhancing the site's innovation culture.

items.title: Future of Workplace & Community
items.hmw: How might we reimagine Microsoft's workplace experience to foster community, well-being, and high-performance culture?
items.challenge: Elevate the everyday experience: transform the campus into a destination that strengthens belonging, enhances well-being, and supports evolving hybrid work behaviours.
outcome: Activation levers across food, space and services
items.results: Positioned Microsoft with a compelling, human-centered workplace vision — enhancing engagement, strengthening community, and reinforcing the campus as a true destination.

items.title: Fan Experience
items.hmw: How might we reimagine a seamless, electrifying fan experience across St James' Park for all supporter profiles?
items.challenge: Create a seamless fan experience: emotionally engaging for all supporter profiles, from families to fanatics, while unlocking new commercial opportunities for the club.
approach: Priorities around mobility, engagement, convenience and digital upgrades
Opportunities mapped across the before–during–after match experience
outcome: Shared vision for the future fan experience
Value mapping: fast access, strong atmosphere, smooth F&B, seamless digital touchpoints
Roadmap across three horizons (quick wins, mid-term, long term)
items.results: Helped shape a reinvented, high-impact fan ecosystem that deepens belonging, enhances stadium flow, amplifies match-day entertainment, and positions Newcastle United at the forefront of digital and experiential innovation.

items.title: Rethinking the zoo visitor's experience
items.hmw: How might we create a more immersive, sustainable, and digitally enhanced zoo experience that drives engagement, loyalty, and revenue?
items.challenge: Elevate the visitor experience: enhance the family and event journey by addressing operational friction, limited immersion and under-leveraged sustainability opportunities — while reinforcing the zoo's conservation mission.
approach: Personas: family visitors and event planners
outcome: Digital tools to streamline events and ordering
Impact vs. feasibility roadmap (quick wins → long term)
items.results: Positioned Edinburgh Zoo with a bold innovation vision — blending education, sustainability, and immersive technology to increase engagement, optimise operations, and unlock new premium revenue streams.

items.title: HQ Workplace Experience
items.hmw: How might we reinvent the Santander HQ campus experience to support renewal strategy, employee engagement, and operational excellence?
items.challenge: Reinvent the campus experience: support Santander's renewal ambition by elevating the workplace and food experience — reducing friction, increasing engagement, and aligning services with evolving employee expectations.
outcome: Phased roadmap supporting contract renewal and long-term value
items.results: Strengthened Santander's renewal strategy with a compelling, future-ready campus experience vision — enhancing employee satisfaction, operational performance, and commercial attractiveness.

items.title: Designing Military Experience
items.hmw: How might we redesign the service model to create a more efficient, user-centered, and future-ready FM experience?
items.challenge: Modernise the service ecosystem: address operational complexity, fragmented user journeys and evolving workplace expectations — while improving efficiency, service clarity and perceived value.
outcome: Phased roadmap aligned with performance and cost objectives
items.results: Positioned DSFM with a modernised, scalable service model — improving user satisfaction, operational efficiency, and long-term contract resilience.

items.title: Next Generation of Senior Communities
items.hmw: How might we redesign the senior living experience to meet the expectations of the Baby Boomer generation and position Jardins d'Arcadie as a true destination?
items.challenge: Reinvent the senior living experience: adapt services and community life to evolving expectations — moving beyond traditional senior housing toward a more dynamic, lifestyle-driven model.
outcome: Renewed value proposition to differentiate the brand
items.results: Positioned Les Jardins d'Arcadie with a modern, lifestyle-oriented senior living vision — strengthening attractiveness, differentiation, and long-term competitiveness.

items.title: Aligning leadership around a bold experience vision
items.hmw: How might we align COMEX leadership around a shared innovation vision to accelerate growth and differentiation in Live venues?
items.challenge: Create strategic alignment at leadership level: clarify priorities across premium experience, operational excellence and innovation — while strengthening differentiation in a competitive hospitality and events market.
items.results: Strengthened executive alignment around a future-ready Live strategy — accelerating decision-making, focusing investment priorities, and reinforcing competitive positioning.

items.title: Reimagining the next-generation lounge experience
items.hmw: How might we elevate the premium lounge experience while driving next-generation operational excellence?
items.challenge: Balance premium experience and operational efficiency: enhance the lounge journey for diverse traveller personas while addressing congestion, service speed, F&B expectations and operational complexity.
approach: Immersive benchmarking (luxury hospitality, retail, CES and NRF tech trends)
outcome: Target personas for typical and premium guests
items.results: Aligned Sodexo Live and American Airlines on a bold, innovation-driven vision — enhancing premium differentiation, improving operational flow, and structuring a scalable roadmap for lounge transformation.

items.title: Improving everyday experience for frontline workers
items.hmw: How might we enhance the daily experience of blue-collar workers — a group often overlooked in traditional service design?
items.challenge: Elevate the frontline employee experience: address unmet daily needs across factory environments — from access to services and food to well-being, recognition and operational friction.
items.results: Helped Colgate and Sodexo build a more inclusive, operationally grounded employee experience vision — improving engagement, equity, and everyday impact for frontline teams.

items.title: Rethinking food experience in care & memory units
items.hmw: How might we redesign the dining experience across dining rooms, floors, and memory care units to create more joyful, meaningful moments?
items.challenge: Transform mealtime into a meaningful experience: move beyond functional food delivery to create moments of pleasure, autonomy and social connection for residents — while supporting staff efficiency.
outcome: Weekly co-creation workshops for menu planning
Clear service standards and process improvements
Roadmap to scale across dining rooms and care units
items.results: Positioned Clariane with a more human-centered dining experience — increasing resident engagement, strengthening autonomy, and improving overall care satisfaction.

items.title: Reinventing the service & hospitality experience of an iconic office campus
items.hmw: How might we reposition Cœur Défense as a premium service destination to increase tenant attractiveness, enhance occupant engagement, and create sustainable competitive advantage?
items.challenge: From landmark asset to experiential destination: strong brand recognition but evolving post-Covid workplace expectations and growing competition from hospitality-driven assets. Existing services were functional yet lacked differentiation, coherence and community activation.
approach: Phased transformation roadmap (quick wins → structural moves)
outcome: Priority levers: reception, F&B strategy, daily services, community programming
Operating model integrating delivery, animation and performance steering
items.results: Repositioned Cœur Défense as an experience-driven office destination — enhancing workplace quality perception, strengthening leasing attractiveness, and reinforcing strategic differentiation in a highly competitive market.

items.title: Food & Beverage Experience
items.hmw: How might we transform food & beverage into a seamless, iconic experience that enhances every moment of Roland-Garros for spectators, players, and staff?
items.challenge: Create a signature Roland-Garros experience: transform catering from a functional service into a memorable part of the tournament journey, balancing very high visitor volumes with premium standards — fluidity, quality and emotional impact for the general public, players, staff and VIP guests.
approach: Key moments of the visitor and player journeys
outcome: Personas and journey maps across spectators, players, families and staff
Impact mapping and prioritisation (quick wins and long-term innovation)
items.results: Helped shape a future-ready food & hospitality ecosystem that enhances visitor satisfaction, improves operational flow, and reinforces Roland-Garros as a global benchmark for premium sporting experiences.

items.title: Food experience
items.hmw: How can we transform mealtime into a more human, participatory experience adapted to the needs of the inhabitants, while remaining effective for the teams?
items.challenge: Changing a constrained model: a standardised restaurant model with menus that are not very customisable and an experience that is sometimes endured — a wide variety of profiles (age, autonomy, cognitive abilities), high expectations of fun, choice and participation, and significant organisational constraints.
approach: Gathering insights: meal needs, frustrations and expectations
Collaborative workshops with residents and field teams
Accessibility: visual aids, simplicity, adaptation to abilities
outcome: « Rendez-vous des colocs » participatory workshop format
Simple voting system to give residents a voice
Structured feedback loop to kitchen and teams
items.results: A more participatory, inclusive and structured catering model, which strengthens the autonomy of the inhabitants while improving the coordination and performance of the teams.

items.title: Expérience restauration
items.hmw: Comment concevoir une expérience de restauration fluide et impactante, au service du bien-être, de l'efficacité et du lien ?
items.challenge: Transformer l'expérience de restauration : réduire les points de friction (attente, visibilité, accès) et répondre aux attentes de qualité, flexibilité et convivialité.
outcome: Vision cible de l'expérience de restauration
items.results: Positionner Abeille avec un écosystème de restauration fluide et attractif, améliorant satisfaction, performance et lien social.

items.title: Workplace & Culinary Experience Convergence
items.hmw: How might we create a unified, modern and engaging campus experience that elevates well-being, fluidity, and culinary excellence across three highly heterogeneous Thales sites?
items.challenge: Rebuilding a coherent, high-value campus experience: three sites with inconsistent services, long waits, noise, mobility friction, digital gaps and perceived inequalities. Thales needs aligned offers, a shared vision and rapid satisfaction improvement while preparing a future premium site.
approach: Research and insights: on-site immersion, pain points across mobility, dining, workspace, digital
Prioritisation across 5 themes (gastronomy, well-being, digitalisation, mobility, community)
outcome: Unified experience vision across the 3 sites
Guiding principles: fluidity, comfort, sustainability, digital simplicity
Prioritised levers: hybrid food models, mobility, premium social spaces, super-app
30 validated opportunities and site-specific experience territories
items.results: Smoother daily journeys, enhanced dining and well-being, with offers and governance aligned through digitalised services — strengthening Thales' employer brand and boosting engagement.

items.title: Food and visitor experience transformation
items.hmw: How might we elevate a seamless, culturally distinctive and digitally-enhanced visitor & dining experience across the Scottish Parliament for all user profiles?
items.challenge: Build a coherent, modern experience for parliamentarians, staff, journalists, families and tourists. Touchpoints lack digital support, flow efficiency and visibility of food services, with limited cultural storytelling and fragmented space usage.
approach: Field studies, interviews, personas (Parliamentarian, Family Visitor), journey analysis
Co-creation workshops: 8 idea sheets, 2 journeys, cross-theme ideation
Benchmarking: canteens, immersive venues, autonomous retail, tourism trends
Impact/feasibility prioritisation (Lunch Box, AI Bot, Sensory Welcome, Pre-Visit Digital Platform)
outcome: Experience vision anchored in culture, accessibility, sustainability
Priority opportunities: arrival & welcome, food & local culture, digital enablement, immersive learning
Roadmap: quick wins (QR help, sensory arrival), mid-term (omnichannel ordering, AI bot), long-term (AR/VR Parliament World)
Operational enablers: digital tools, local producers, staff capability uplift
items.results: A stronger, clearer experience that increases visitor engagement with Scottish culture, improves flow through digital tools, boosts tourism via immersive activities, and advances sustainability through local sourcing and reduced waste.

items.title: Food and hospitality experience transformation
items.hmw: How might we redesign a seamless, modern, and culturally engaging food & hospitality experience across the European Parliament for all resident and visitor profiles?
items.challenge: Modernise a complex, multi-audience ecosystem for MEPs, assistants, staff, journalists, school groups, retirees and visitors. Uneven food quality, limited information, flow bottlenecks, fragmented experiences between Strasbourg and Brussels, and minimal cultural representation.
approach: Immersion and insights: site visits, interviews, observation, personas (MEP, Assistant, Journalist, Groups)
Journey mapping: 4 consumer journeys, 10 opportunity tracks
Co-creation workshop: 1 workshop, 10 participants, 273 post-its, concept sheets
Benchmarking: canteens, immersive venues, autonomous stores, visitor centres
outcome: Experience vision: modern, fluid, culturally rich
Priority levers: flows, wider choice, personalisation, cultural touchpoints, hybrid on-site/mobile services
Concepts: RestoSmart, Room-Service Lockers, Nomadic Tricycles, Concierge & Wellbeing, Gourmet Trip, Fidelity Time
Roadmap: quick wins (signage, micromarket, pre-order) → mid-term → long-term
items.results: A stronger, seamless and culturally meaningful experience that enhances user satisfaction, improves operational fluidity, celebrates European diversity and supports sustainable, modern food services.

items.title: Reinventing the everyday food experience
items.hmw: How might we reinvent Seazon's food experience to unlock growth, strengthen perceived value, and shift from a rigid subscription model to a flexible, intuitive and emotionally supportive everyday food solution?
items.challenge: A brand at a turning point: declining active users, reduced visibility and a perceived price–value gap despite strong product quality. The subscription model creates rigidity, mental load and delivery frustrations.
approach: Insights and immersion: benchmark, user tests (delivery, packaging, taste), brand perception, factory visit
2 co-design workshops: 125 ideas, 19 game changers across 5 universes (WORK, HEAL, LEARN, PLAY, RETAIL)
outcome: Vision: flexible, healthy and emotionally supportive everyday food
Principles: fluidity, modularity, personalisation, transparency, pleasure
Levers: larger formats, loyalty, multi-channel access, partnerships
8 deployable concepts with business models and digital enablers
items.results: Seazon can deliver a simpler, more flexible and more engaging food experience, improve operational reliability and perceived value, and unlock stronger loyalty and new growth segments.

items.title: Rethinking the sustainability roadmap for 2030
items.hmw: How might we redesign and prioritise the Saint-Gatien sustainability journey to build a shared 2030 roadmap aligned with the group's vision and the quality–cost–durability decision triangle?
items.challenge: Build a unified, ambitious and actionable CSR vision: move from dispersed initiatives to a structured trajectory integrating environmental, social and operational priorities, with a shared culture of sustainability.
approach: Site inputs, workshops, voting sessions, interviews
outcome: 12 priority initiatives sequenced by impact and feasibility
Pilots and progressive deployment across sites
Operational toolkits (safety, water, cleaning, food service)
items.results: Saint-Gatien now benefits from a clear, shared and actionable sustainability trajectory — strengthening safety culture, accelerating environmental and food transitions, and improving social and ecological performance.
